title: Liposomal Silymarin for Fatty Liver Health - KNOWLEDGE - Bolin
abstract:
Due to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-fibrotic properties, silymarin is one of the most commonly used natural compounds for treating liver diseases. Research has found that all components of silymarin can inhibit lipid peroxidation. It protects mitochondria and microsomes in rat hepatocytes from damage caused by chemicals associated with in vitro lipid peroxidation. Silymarin is said to improve ribosomal, DNA, and protein synthesis; it increases the production of ribosomal proteins in cell membranes and nuclei by stimulating the transcription of nuclear RNA polymerase I and rRNA, respectively. Hepatotoxin-damaged structural proteins and enzymes are restored, which supports tissue healing and protein production.  
Nevertheless, silymarin's low water solubility (0.04 mg/mL) limits its bioavailability, resulting in oral absorption rates generally between 23% and 47%. Liposomal Silymarin, an improved product that gets over the application bottlenecks of conventional raw materials, was created as a result of the introduction of liposomal technology.
## **Why choose Vesilipo™ Liposomal Silymarin?**  
**1. Increase bioavailability by 3-5 times:**The bilayer vesicles of liposomes can encapsulate silymarin, preventing its degradation in gastric acid and promoting its dissolution and absorption in the intestine, thereby increasing the absorption efficiency to 15%-25%, which is 3-5 times that of traditional silymarin. This means that a low dose of Liposomal Milk Thistle extract can achieve the liver-protecting effect of a traditional high-dose product, significantly reducing the raw material usage and production costs of the final product.  
**2. Targeted delivery, precise liver care:** The nanoscale structure of liposomes (with a particle size typically ranging from 50 to 200 nm) can penetrate the intestinal barrier and directly deliver silymarin to liver cells, reducing the loss of active ingredients in other organs, achieving "targeted liver protection", making the effect more concentrated and efficient, especially suitable for long-term conditioning of people with slightly impaired liver function.
**Misconception 2:** The higher the encapsulation rate, the better the product quality? - Encapsulation rate is one of the core indicators (recommended ≥ 80%), but it is not necessarily the higher the better. It needs to be judged comprehensively based on the purity of silymarin, the quality of phospholipids, and the uniformity of particle size. The synergy of these three factors can achieve the best absorption effect and product stability.  
**Misconception 3:** Liposomal silymarin is expensive and has low cost performance? - Although the unit price of Vesilipo™ liposomal silymarin is higher than that of traditional silymarin, its high absorption efficiency allows the raw material dosage of the final product to be reduced by more than 60%. Comprehensive calculation shows that it can reduce the production cost of the final product and enhance product competitiveness. In the long run, the cost performance is higher.  
**Misconception 4:** Can liposomal silymarin replace drug treatment for liver diseases? - It should be clearly stated that Liposomal Milk Thistle extract is a natural raw material, mainly used for liver maintenance and auxiliary treatment of diseases. It cannot replace drugs. The final product should clearly indicate "cannot replace drugs" to avoid compliance risks.
